solution_units.title: Requirements-to-release evidence chain
solution_units.business_outcome: Convert versioned requirements and technical artifacts into traceable test and release evidence without allowing AI to invent authority.
solution_units.failure_cost: Unsupported rules, missed state conflicts or false-green release evidence can create financial, authorization and release risk.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: What business outcome, measurable success, failure cost and accountable decision owner govern this solution?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Document the intended business decision and failure cost, but keep the owner unassigned until a qualified organization representative accepts it.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Which systems, users, environments and exclusions define the solution boundary?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Freeze the synthetic/local boundary and list every real system or organization context as outside current evidence.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Who is responsible, accountable, consulted and informed, and who may approve, waive, escalate or stop work?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Preserve role-level gates and mark accountable practitioner and business owners unassigned; AI has no approval authority.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: What current workflow, tools, bottlenecks, baseline data and failure modes are evidenced?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Use the existing research and fixture baseline only; target-company workflow and performance remain unknown.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are primary, exception, abuse and recovery cases plus functional and quality requirements explicit?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Retain current scenario requirements as design inputs and block any unsupported target-environment requirement.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Which policy, privacy, access, latency, budget, platform and organizational dependencies constrain the solution?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Record public and fixture constraints; require a target-environment discovery before selecting production thresholds or access.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Were viable options, trade-offs, rejected alternatives and revisit evidence recorded?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Adopt offline/live separation and human authority as bounded decisions; other choices remain proposed until practitioner review.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Can reviewers reconstruct external actors, trust boundaries, component responsibilities and ownership?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Provide a repository-owned context and building-block view while leaving external adapter ownership unassigned.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are happy path, exceptions, retries, timeouts, cancellation, stop states and human handoff explicit?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Model PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN separately; real retry and timeout behavior remains untested.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are local, CI, staging and production topology, network, secrets, configuration and telemetry defined?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Document the target deployment shape as NOT_RUN; do not infer a deployable topology from local files.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are API, event and file contracts, authentication, errors, idempotency, compatibility and external integrations proven?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Keep all real service boundaries at gap until a controlled adapter run produces a structured receipt.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are acquisition, schema, lineage, quality, splits, retention, privacy, access, deletion and drift controlled?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Use synthetic fixture data only and require organization-specific retention, deletion and access decisions before integration.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are model, prompt, RAG, tool and agent versions, limits, evaluation, fallback and approval boundaries explicit?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Version local prompt/eval artifacts where present; provider execution and privileged AI authority remain NOT_RUN/prohibited.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are assets, threats, trust boundaries, RBAC, secrets, PII, supply chain, audit and compliance obligations reviewed?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Provide a design trust-boundary view but keep security review and target compliance obligations unknown.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are risks, levels, datasets, oracles, slices, statistics, regression, mutation, acceptance and human review defined?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Use independent oracles and meaningful mutation where available; do not generalize one fixture result across a solution unit.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are workload, concurrency, distributions, throughput, token/tool cost, budget and saturation signals calibrated?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Treat all displayed thresholds as examples until a real workload, owner and priced version are run and approved.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are SLO, error budget, degradation, dependency failure, RTO/RPO, backup and recovery exercises evidenced?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Keep operational resilience at gap; local failure injection is not disaster-recovery or production evidence.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, on-call, runbooks, incidents and feedback loops operational?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Document required signals and handoffs, while keeping external telemetry and On-call operation NOT_RUN.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are code, configuration, data, versions, commands, environment and ownership reproducible?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Reference repository-owned artifacts and exact local commands where they exist; pages without labs explicitly remain NOT_RUN.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are pilot, flags, compatibility, migration, canary, promotion, rollback and kill-switch evidence available?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: No rollout is authorized; rollback remains a design requirement until exercised in a controlled integration environment.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are milestones, dependencies, staffing, estimates, reviewers and handoffs owned?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Record dependency order and missing roles; do not invent staffing, estimates or organizational commitments.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are ranked risks, assumptions, unknowns, debt, triggers, owners and closure evidence explicit?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Maintain owned-by-role residual risks and leave organization-specific owners unassigned rather than silently closing gaps.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Do prerequisites, progression, demonstrations, runnable materials, expected results, diagnosis, assessment and transfer support learning?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Retain current learning artifacts but keep pages with missing executable paths or research packages below completion.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Can each page trace from coverage and scenario to artifact, command, receipt, assessment and human gate?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Create exact rows; use NOT_RUN for missing execution and only reference TD-P02 fixture PASS from its fresh structured receipt.

dimensions.question: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Are refresh triggers, compatibility windows, golden-set evolution, deprecation, migration and change log owned?
dimensions.decision: Requirements-to-release evidence chain: Record version and deprecation obligations; real refresh ownership and compatibility windows remain unassigned.

solution_units.title: AI system evaluation and governance
solution_units.business_outcome: Version datasets, models, prompts, retrieval, tools, scorers and human gates so AI release decisions remain reproducible and bounded.
solution_units.failure_cost: Contamination, judge error, unsafe tool behavior or untracked version changes can promote a harmful or regressed AI system.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: What business outcome, measurable success, failure cost and accountable decision owner govern this solution?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Document the intended business decision and failure cost, but keep the owner unassigned until a qualified organization representative accepts it.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Which systems, users, environments and exclusions define the solution boundary?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Freeze the synthetic/local boundary and list every real system or organization context as outside current evidence.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Who is responsible, accountable, consulted and informed, and who may approve, waive, escalate or stop work?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Preserve role-level gates and mark accountable practitioner and business owners unassigned; AI has no approval authority.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: What current workflow, tools, bottlenecks, baseline data and failure modes are evidenced?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Use the existing research and fixture baseline only; target-company workflow and performance remain unknown.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are primary, exception, abuse and recovery cases plus functional and quality requirements explicit?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Retain current scenario requirements as design inputs and block any unsupported target-environment requirement.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Which policy, privacy, access, latency, budget, platform and organizational dependencies constrain the solution?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Record public and fixture constraints; require a target-environment discovery before selecting production thresholds or access.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Were viable options, trade-offs, rejected alternatives and revisit evidence recorded?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Adopt offline/live separation and human authority as bounded decisions; other choices remain proposed until practitioner review.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Can reviewers reconstruct external actors, trust boundaries, component responsibilities and ownership?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Provide a repository-owned context and building-block view while leaving external adapter ownership unassigned.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are happy path, exceptions, retries, timeouts, cancellation, stop states and human handoff explicit?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Model PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, UNKNOWN and NOT_RUN separately; real retry and timeout behavior remains untested.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are local, CI, staging and production topology, network, secrets, configuration and telemetry defined?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Document the target deployment shape as NOT_RUN; do not infer a deployable topology from local files.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are API, event and file contracts, authentication, errors, idempotency, compatibility and external integrations proven?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Keep all real service boundaries at gap until a controlled adapter run produces a structured receipt.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are acquisition, schema, lineage, quality, splits, retention, privacy, access, deletion and drift controlled?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Use synthetic fixture data only and require organization-specific retention, deletion and access decisions before integration.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are model, prompt, RAG, tool and agent versions, limits, evaluation, fallback and approval boundaries explicit?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Version local prompt/eval artifacts where present; provider execution and privileged AI authority remain NOT_RUN/prohibited.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are assets, threats, trust boundaries, RBAC, secrets, PII, supply chain, audit and compliance obligations reviewed?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Provide a design trust-boundary view but keep security review and target compliance obligations unknown.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are risks, levels, datasets, oracles, slices, statistics, regression, mutation, acceptance and human review defined?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Use independent oracles and meaningful mutation where available; do not generalize one fixture result across a solution unit.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are workload, concurrency, distributions, throughput, token/tool cost, budget and saturation signals calibrated?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Treat all displayed thresholds as examples until a real workload, owner and priced version are run and approved.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are SLO, error budget, degradation, dependency failure, RTO/RPO, backup and recovery exercises evidenced?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Keep operational resilience at gap; local failure injection is not disaster-recovery or production evidence.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alerts, on-call, runbooks, incidents and feedback loops operational?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Document required signals and handoffs, while keeping external telemetry and On-call operation NOT_RUN.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are code, configuration, data, versions, commands, environment and ownership reproducible?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Reference repository-owned artifacts and exact local commands where they exist; pages without labs explicitly remain NOT_RUN.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are pilot, flags, compatibility, migration, canary, promotion, rollback and kill-switch evidence available?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: No rollout is authorized; rollback remains a design requirement until exercised in a controlled integration environment.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are milestones, dependencies, staffing, estimates, reviewers and handoffs owned?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Record dependency order and missing roles; do not invent staffing, estimates or organizational commitments.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are ranked risks, assumptions, unknowns, debt, triggers, owners and closure evidence explicit?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Maintain owned-by-role residual risks and leave organization-specific owners unassigned rather than silently closing gaps.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Do prerequisites, progression, demonstrations, runnable materials, expected results, diagnosis, assessment and transfer support learning?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Retain current learning artifacts but keep pages with missing executable paths or research packages below completion.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Can each page trace from coverage and scenario to artifact, command, receipt, assessment and human gate?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Create exact rows; use NOT_RUN for missing execution and only reference TD-P02 fixture PASS from its fresh structured receipt.

dimensions.question: AI system evaluation and governance: Are refresh triggers, compatibility windows, golden-set evolution, deprecation, migration and change log owned?
dimensions.decision: AI system evaluation and governance: Record version and deprecation obligations; real refresh ownership and compatibility windows remain unassigned.

decisions.context: AI system evaluation and governance must distinguish locally reproducible teaching evidence from external-system evidence.
options: Treat local fixture success as end-to-end proof
Keep fixture and integration adapters as separate maturity layers
decisions.choice: Keep fixture and integration adapters as separate maturity layers.
decisions.tradeoffs: This prevents false maturity claims but leaves external behavior unknown until a controlled adapter run exists.
decisions.revisit_evidence: A controlled integration receipt demonstrating that the separation prevents needed verification or creates unacceptable maintenance cost.

decisions.context: AI system evaluation and governance includes AI-assisted analysis or automation that may influence professional decisions.
options: Allow model output to approve its own result
Require an independent deterministic or human authority gate
decisions.choice: Require an independent deterministic or human authority gate.
decisions.tradeoffs: Independent review adds latency and staffing needs but prevents the model from defining and approving its own oracle.
decisions.revisit_evidence: Named practitioner approval, calibrated false-positive/false-negative evidence and a documented authority change.
